scenario.topic: Choose a hybrid-work schedule for the product team

options.name: Fixed 3 Days In-Office, 2 Days Remote
options.upside: Ensures regular face-to-face collaboration on set days.
options.concern: Less daily flexibility for individual schedules.

options.name: Flexible In-Office Days with Minimum 2 Days
options.upside: Allows team members to choose in-office days based on personal needs.
options.concern: Potentially uneven in-office overlap among team members.

options.name: Alternating Weeks: One Week In-Office, One Week Remote
options.upside: Maximizes extended remote work periods while maintaining regular office presence.
options.concern: Less frequent in-person interaction within a given week.

options.name: Daily Split: Half-Day In-Office, Half-Day Remote
options.upside: Balances daily in-person collaboration with remote work flexibility.
options.concern: May increase commuting frequency and reduce deep focus time.

shared_context: The product team of 5 members needs to select a hybrid-work schedule balancing in-office collaboration and remote flexibility. Each option specifies days in-office per week and core hours for synchronous work.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a product designer who values daily collaboration and structured schedules.
personas.private_goal: To maximize in-person teamwork without sacrificing daily routine consistency.

A.reason_for: Ensures regular face-to-face collaboration on set days, supporting teamwork.
A.reason_against: Lacks daily flexibility which Maya prefers for her routine.

B.reason_for: Allows some flexibility in choosing in-office days.
B.reason_against: Potential uneven overlap may reduce consistent team presence.

C.reason_against: Less frequent in-person interaction within a given week conflicts with her desire for daily collaboration.

D.reason_for: Balances daily in-person collaboration with remote work flexibility, ideal for Maya’s structured yet flexible needs.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a backend engineer who prefers clear boundaries between work and personal time.
personas.private_goal: To minimize commuting and maximize focus time during work hours.

A.reason_for: Fixed days help with planning but reduce flexibility.
A.reason_against: Less daily flexibility and fixed core hours may interfere with his focus.

B.reason_for: Flexible days allow choosing less commuting days.
B.reason_against: Uneven overlap might disrupt team syncs.

C.reason_for: Extended remote weeks maximize focus time and reduce commuting.

D.reason_for: Daily in-person time is beneficial for collaboration.
D.reason_against: Increases commuting frequency and disrupts focus blocks.

personas.name: Noah
personas.background: Noah is a QA analyst who values predictability and minimal disruptions.
personas.private_goal: To maintain a consistent work environment with minimal commute stress.

A.reason_against: Less flexibility and fixed core hours may cause stress.

B.reason_for: Flexible days offer some choice and reduce commute unpredictability.
B.reason_against: Uneven overlap could cause coordination issues.

C.reason_for: Alternating weeks provide long remote stretches and predictable office presence.

D.reason_against: Half-day commuting is disruptive and tiring.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a UX researcher who enjoys deep focus time and flexible schedules.
personas.private_goal: To have long uninterrupted remote work periods balanced with some office time.

A.reason_for: Regular office days help with team bonding.
A.reason_against: Fixed days reduce flexibility and deep focus time.

B.reason_for: Flexible in-office days allow balancing focus and collaboration.
B.reason_against: Uneven overlap could reduce team cohesion.

C.reason_for: Alternating weeks maximize remote focus periods with regular in-office presence.

D.reason_against: Frequent commuting breaks focus and is tiring.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a product manager who values autonomy and efficient team communication.
personas.private_goal: To have flexible schedules that empower personal productivity and maintain team alignment.

B.reason_for: Flexible in-office days with core hours and flexible start/end times match his autonomy and communication needs.

C.reason_against: Less frequent in-person interaction hinders team alignment.

D.reason_for: Daily split balances collaboration and remote work.
